# Interface and Operations Checklist: Journal and Reflect

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the screens, their states and messages, saving and conflicts, export, accessibility, scale and the change to feature 000's list are complete, clear and consistent before tasks are written.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), with [plan.md](../plan.md), [screens.md](../screens.md) and [contracts/openapi.yaml](../contracts/openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Screens, states and wording

- [ ] CHK001 Does every state in the screen inventory (S0 to S5, 25 states) have a stated source of data in the contract, so nothing on a screen has no field behind it? [Traceability, screens.md, contracts/openapi.yaml]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the states that were not drawn (today with trades and nothing saved, the retire and rename dialogs for mistakes) given written wording and behaviour, since they were accepted exceptions? [Gap, spec.md Signed-off screens, screens.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the wording of each new refusal in the plan present in the wireframe content list or the spec (valid loss "not a loss", a day that has not happened yet, one character over, a stop line above any limit)? [Gap, Spec FR-009, FR-017, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the singular and plural wording of counts ("1 character over", "1 trade changed after you marked this review") stated? [Clarity, screens.md S1, S4]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the account switcher's default (no account given) and whether it is remembered between screens stated, and is the behaviour with no accounts or only archived accounts defined? [Gap, screens.md S0, S1, S5]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it stated what S1 and S5 show for an account that is archived (reviews of its past days remain readable and editable)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the home screen (where `/` leads) and the navigation order (Reviews, Trades, Mistakes, Accounts, Settings) stated, including that the 000 screens keep working unchanged? [Gap, screens.md Navigation]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the Plan column on the Trades list specified (its values, its wording for not judged yet, where it sits beside the net result), since it changes a signed-off screen of 000? [Gap, plan.md Constitution Check, research.md §11]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated that the 000 wireframes and `screens.md` are updated in the same change as the Plan column, and the S2 button text corrected, per principle V? [Traceability, Constitution V, plan.md]

## Saving, leaving and conflicts

- [ ] CHK010 Is it stated what happens to typed answers when the owner leaves a daily review without saving (a prompt as in 000, an automatic draft, or loss)? [Gap, Spec FR-006, US1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated whether "Save draft" and "Mark as reviewed" save the grades and the answers together, and whether grades alone can be saved? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-006, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the behaviour of the judge drawer defined (explicit Save and Cancel, what Close does with unsaved changes, and that saving does not change the day's reviewed state)? [Gap, screens.md S2, Spec FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Are out-of-date saves (two windows) addressed for a daily review, a judgement, a focus and a mistake, with the same wording style as 000? [Coverage, Gap, 000 FR-022]
- [ ] CHK014 Are loading and failure notices for every write (could not reach the journal, nothing saved, typed text kept) required to match 000's behaviour? [Consistency, 000 FR-023, Spec FR-012]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it stated whether undo is offered for clearing a focus, retiring a mistake or marking a week reviewed? [Gap, Spec FR-013, FR-017, FR-021a]

## Export, accessibility and scale

- [ ] CHK016 Does the export requirement list every kind of record it must contain (mistakes, reviews, focuses, weekly marks, day-level mistakes, judgements) and say where the owner finds it? [Completeness, Spec FR-025, research.md §10, screens.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Are keyboard and screen-reader requirements stated for the new controls (the star grade, the judge drawer, the focus dialog, the day and week pickers, collapsible weeks)? [Gap, 000 FR-024, screens.md]
- [ ] CHK018 Are status words (Missing, Draft, Reviewed, STOP TRADING) and the picker marks (• has trades, ! review missing) required to carry meaning in text, never by colour or shape alone? [Consistency, Constitution I, screens.md, 000 FR-024]
- [ ] CHK019 Is a data size and a response time stated for the new screens, as 000's SC-008 did, since this feature has no performance criterion? [Gap, Spec Success Criteria, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it stated how SC-001 (five minutes) and SC-005 (8 of 10 days) are measured, given there is no usage tracking? [Measurability, Spec SC-001, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it stated that existing 000 records and the migrations are safe: the new migrations run in a transaction and change nothing on failure, and the starter mistakes are seeded once? [Coverage, 000 FR-025, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Is local-only operation (loopback only, no sign-in or audit log, the written exception) restated for every new endpoint and for the export of reviews? [Consistency, Spec FR-022, Constitution IV]
